messages:
marta_pm: Heads-up — we've got two large asks from two customers this week: bankA wants an end-to-end Console experience (audit logs, role-based UI, model pinning), while infra-platform wants an API-first rollout with SDKs and rollout policies. Need to decide scope for Q3.

alex_engineer: Quick clarifying q: are both asks blocking revenue? bankA is a contract renewal, right?

marta_pm: bankA renewal is unlikely without some Console controls (audit + RBAC). infra-platform's ask is more about scaling launch velocity for internal teams (not immediate $).

sam_product: Suggest we use a prioritization lens: RICE + sequencing. We can slice the Console into a "lite" onboarding UI that unlocks bankA, while doing API + SDK for broader adopters.

junaid_infra: From infra POV, rolling out API-first is lower ops risk. Console features add stateful components (sessions, RBAC management, audit store). That increases SLO work.

emily_research: Also consider quality/regression risk: Console UIs encourage non-dev users to try edge flows — increases support.

marta_pm: Agreed. Proposed approach:
- Ship API v1 (text generation, model pinning via config) + SDKs in 2 sprints.
- Parallel: Console Lite (RBAC, basic audit view, model pin) with reduced polish but meeting bankA acceptance criteria.
- Defer advanced Console analytics & routing UI to Q4.

sam_product: Can we RICE-score bankA Console mini-feature vs API-first effort? Quick draft:
```
Feature          Reach Impact Confidence Effort R*I*C/E
BankA Console    1k/mo  6      0.8        3     1k*6*0.8/3 = 1600
API+SDK          10k/mo 4      0.9        5     10k*4*0.9/5 = 7200
```
(rough numbers)

alex_engineer: That math favors API+SDK for long-term reach but bankA is immediate. Suggest we mark bankA Console as high-urgency with risk mitigation: keep data plane out of Console (just links to audit logs stored in KMS-backed S3) to reduce surface area.

junaid_infra: Technical note: if we expose model pinning in Console we need server-side validation plus audit trail. I can own an initial spec for pinned-model API and immutability events.

marta_pm: Acceptance criteria for bankA feature (must satisfy before renewal):
- RBAC: create/read/update roles + assignment flows (happy path)
- Audit: all model pin and rollout changes are logged and exportable
- Model pinning API exists and is versioned
- End-to-end test covering provisioning + audit export

emily_research: Also add a quality criterion: regression checks for prompt outputs on pinned model baseline. If pinned model drifts, auto-notify. That can be soft launch but at least alerts on failure.

sam_product: Notes on sequencing:
1) API+SDK baseline (enables broad dev adoption)
2) Console Lite (unblocks bankA)
3) Console analytics + rollout UI (Q4)

marta_pm: Scope negotiation: bankA wanted full Console UX, but we'll offer "Console Lite + SLAs + exportable audit" as contract annex. If they accept, we keep larger Console roadmap for general availability later.

alex_engineer: Task breakdown (owners):
- pinned-model API + validation (junaid_infra)
- SDK binding + examples (alex_engineer)
- Console Lite RBAC screens + audit view (sam_product + ux contractor)
- E2E tests + regression suite (emily_research)
deploy-bot: deploy request queued for branch/feature/pinned-model-api -> staging. CI: 6 checks queued.

marta_pm: Timeline ask: Can we do API+SDK in 3 weeks and Console Lite in 6? If yes, I'll present to bankA.

alex_engineer: 3 weeks for API+SDK is tight but ok if we scope SDK to simple bindings and docs, no advanced pagination/streaming polish.

junaid_infra: 6 weeks for Console Lite looks feasible if we keep backend simple and reuse existing auth service. Will prepare spec by EOD tomorrow.

sam_product: I'll prepare a minimal UX flow and acceptance checklist by Friday.

emily_research: I'll slot regression tests into our nightly evals and add an alert on metric drift.

marta_pm: Great. Decision: API-first core, Console Lite for bankA on fast path. We'll track RICE for subsequent Console expansions. I'll update the roadmap doc and send contract annex draft.

alex_engineer: +1. One caveat: we need to call out non-goals in PRD (no analytics, no visual rollout builder).

sam_product: Noted. Draft PRD bullet list incoming.

marta_pm: Thanks team — I'll email bankA with this plan after PRD draft lands.

deploy-bot: CI checks passed for feature/pinned-model-api -> ready for staging deploy (6/6).
